name: Input test
author: Edgemodders
description: Checks keys and modifiers reaching a page (#33, #34): Ctrl, Shift and Alt on clicks, a board with its own Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+A beside a text field where they edit text, and Take Esc, which asks for Esc with the web's Keyboard Lock API. Every event shows in the log.
